title: FRED Commodity Prices and Divergences
description: Global commodity price surveillance via FRED. Tracks WTI + Brent crude spot, Henry Hub natural gas, gold London PM fix, World Bank monthly copper/aluminum/corn/wheat/soybeans. Reports latest price, 30-day % change, 90-day % change, regime flag (SURGING/RISING/STEADY/FALLING/COLLAPSING), and an investment thesis keyed to the category (oil supply shock → long USO/XLE; gold surge → risk-off GLD/GDX/miners; copper surge → global manufacturing expansion FCX/COPX; grain surge → CORN/WEAT/SOYB + ag-machinery DE/AGCO). Each row carries the most-liquid ETF ticker for the underlying. Uses existing FRED_API_KEY.
